stem.text: A minimum torque of $20\,\text{N m}$ must be applied to the lid of a jar for it to open. The radius of the lid is $4.0\,\text{cm}$.

stem.alt: Circle representing the lid, with a radius of 4.0 cm drawn from the centre, and two forces F drawn as vertical arrows on opposite sides, one up and one down.

stem.text: What is the minimum force $F$ that must act on each side of the lid in order to open it?
